verdict.rationale: Zero's README states it does not track, collect, or sell user data at all. That makes an opt-out largely moot rather than offering a documented opt-out control. The claim is a single first-party marketing line with no technical documentation or independent verification. Missing for 10: documented telemetry/analytics settings or env flags, technical detail on what data (if any) the hosted service collects, independent or hands-on verification of the no-tracking claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Your emails, your data. Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way.
